title: sgl-project/sglang: high-performance serving for language and multimodal models
friendlyTitle: SGLang helps teams run large AI models efficiently
summary: SGLang is an Apache-licensed serving framework for large language, vision-language and diffusion models, with more than 30,000 stars and very active development. It focuses on high-throughput inference, model compatibility and production deployment across modern accelerators.
friendlySummary: This popular open project serves language, image and multimodal models with a focus on speed and production use.
whyItMatters: Infrastructure teams can use SGLang to serve open models behind APIs, benchmark throughput and tune inference across supported hardware. Start with a representative workload and verify output quality, latency, memory use and operational complexity against alternatives such as vLLM.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to run open models behind an API and test performance on your hardware. Compare speed, cost, memory and output quality before choosing it.
